subject: Code-cap histogram complete: 15/15; packets persisted
body: Follow-up to my 30-refusal root cause. Captured all 15 generic TGP2 packets (7 P0 v2 + 6 P1 + 2 stagein P1): 15/15 code bytes >4096 (4736..14848), 15/15 old parser rc=-2, 15/15 new parse rc=0 with pipeline_format.h 51cf599d, manifest4..11, local1,1,1. Evidence: workers/compute/evidence-tgp2-code-cap.json; packet bytes remain under /tmp/failing-packets2 and can be persisted if wanted. The fix is deterministic; lowering L2 is already rebuilding compiler with 51cf. TGP1 remains 4096. No production ABI change.
